title: Page 3
content_zh:
赵若瑜往来的皆是高门大户、世族权贵，除非养成纨裤，否则这些小男童日后长大成就、出路必不会太差，她已经在重点撒网，想从中挑出可用的人为其所用。

她目前的目标是先从世家子弟下手，若有更好的人选再择枝别栖，打小就相处的情分远超过长大后的媒妁之言。

第一章 两个穿越女(2)

“小姐，走慢点，小心阶梯。”一看到小姐从阶梯上往下跳后，回过头扮了个俏皮的鬼脸，心口一紧的温香好笑又紧张，担心小姐一个不慎扭伤了脚，她和软玉可是吃罪不小。

“温香、软玉，跟紧点，要是跟丢了我可不要等你们。”在没人瞧见的私底下，赵若瑾也是很顽皮的。

“小姐……”两人哭笑不得的跟着不走直路的主子，斜着走的小人儿忽东忽西，让她们也走起弯路了。

兴武侯府有一座长年不结冰的大湖，横亘在东、西两院之间，喜欢湖水的赵若瑾挑了个近湖的院子，她让人在东院这边的湖畔植满绿柳和桃树，每当春天一到，桃红柳绿，美不胜收。

此时正是桃花盛开的季节，近百株的桃树一夕花开满枝桠，青绿色的杨柳垂枝湖面上，桃红中带着青翠，翠绿中又有点点嫣绿，风一吹，湖面上荡漾着红红绿绿的美景。

哇！真美。看傻的赵若瑾又驻足了，久久不肯移步，她觉得自己太幸福了，能重获新生在勋贵府邸，还是受宠的嫡女，老天爷太厚爱她了，她一定要勤拜佛，让这般的好日子一直持续下去。

“唉！小姐又犯傻了。”软玉一脸苦笑。

“别胡说了，小姐只是有一点点傻气……”温香也是一脸莫可奈何，无力的为自家小姐辩解一句。

所有人都觉得赵若瑾傻，这便正中她下怀，虽然是无心插柳之举，不过效果非常令她满意——所谓枪打出头鸟，她绝不做那只被打下来的傻鸟，傻一点有什么关系，人傻事才少。

而那位木秀于林的秀木正用心的表现自己，有了才名在身的她还不满足，她还要更上一层楼，让全部人的目光都集中在她身上，一个故事只能有一个主角，那就是她。

“姊，你怎么来得这么慢，你的腿又不比我的短，走着走着还能跌进湖里去不成？”看到赵若瑾乌黑油亮的秀发，发尾枯干的赵若瑜嫉妒得要命，忍不住就讥讽她两句。

两姊妹虽是容貌相似的双胞胎，但不表示感情一定比别的姊妹好，就像瑜亮情结，有我无他，平日不冷不热的处着，一点也看不出亲姊妹的热络。

通常孪生子是睡同一屋里，可是也不知是两人天生不和，还是都为注重隐私权的穿越人士，三岁不到就分房住了，各有各的院落以及服侍的下人，彼此的居处相隔甚远。

赵若瑾猜想赵若瑜生前是落水而亡，因此十分惧水，她说什么也不肯搬到离水近的院子，宁可绕远路也不从湖边过，姊妹俩的院子正好是东院的两端。

不过这样也有好处，到父母的主屋是距离相同，没有谁近谁远，倒是侯府两位少爷的居处离赵若瑾比较近，兄弟俩对自家这位傻姊妹特别关照，认为她傻，需要多点关爱，反之赵若瑜精怪多了，不用盯着她也能过得好。

很奇特的现象，明明是孪生妹妹聪慧，讨人喜欢，没人不想变成她，可是大家反而更疼惜姊姊，认为跟她在一起很放松，有种想抛开一切的解脱感，即使她不说一句话，烦躁的心情也会慢慢地沉淀下来。

“我在看鱼。”鱼儿游来游去真好看。

“看鱼？”有个傻姊姊真可恨，为什么自己不是嫡长，独一无二，偏偏冒出个傻子跟她抢嫡姊的风光？

“娘，湖里的鱼又肥又大，我们可不可以捞几只来煮鱼汤、炸鱼片，弄个醋溜什么的来尝尝，乐姊儿想吃。”她真想拿根钓竿，优哉游哉的坐在桃树下等傻鱼上钩。

赵若瑾满脑子想着清蒸鱼头这道菜，用豆腐熬成乳白色汤汁，再煮上一大锅水煮鱼，红得刺眼的辣椒撒在鱼肉上，整锅通红的辣汤，最后淋上酸甜味的鱼肚，滋味软嫩，入口即化。

她脑中有八大名菜的食谱，可一样也拿不出来，她不想赵若瑜发现她也是“同路人”，因此这位有大才的妹妹做了什么她都不会跟风，反而将自身藏得更深。

赵若瑜行事太张狂了，还不到十岁就想把自己一切所知展现在世人面前，以张扬她确实有实才，可是她却未想过十年后她还能拿出什么本事令人信服，届时江郎才尽反倒落得受人耻笑的下场。

一听大女儿只想着吃，愣了一下的侯爷夫人徐氏掩唇轻笑，“乐姊儿想吃鱼？”

“想，超想！”赵若瑾呆萌呆萌地重重点头，一说到“吃”，两眼就发亮的眸子好似湖水粼粼的反光，特别光彩照人。

“好，一会儿我让人拐几条上来，晚上让你喝鱼汤。”女儿想吃是福气，满足她又有何妨？她就这点傻气惹人怜爱。

“嗯，娘真好，有娘疼爱的孩子像个宝。”她呵呵地笑着，不撒娇也不靠近，明亮的双眸澄澈如湖。

“傻丫头……”哪有不疼孩子的娘亲，这可是她身上掉下来的一块肉。

“娘，你就不疼我了，我才是你最爱最爱的小女儿。”无时无刻不在争宠的赵若瑜一下子钻入母亲的怀中，仗着人小又得宠，在母亲的胸前蹭了又蹭，一副这里归我的霸道样。

“疼，都疼，你们都是我的女儿，哪有不疼的道理。”徐氏一手抱着小女儿，一手拉拉大女儿软绵绵小手，笑得心满意足。

有子万事足，有儿有女凑了个好字，再不知足真要遭天打雷劈了，她对目前的生活很满意。

“娘要比较疼我，我最小。”赵若瑜心地不坏，就是喜欢抢第一，凡事以她为先，她不要了别人才能捡。

徐氏笑着轻点她鼻头，“我以为真哥儿才是最小的。”

赵永真四岁，是兴武侯府里的小么儿。

“不一样，他是咱们家里最小的，我是姊妹当中最小的。”对于自家弟弟，她还是有几分怜爱。

“呵呵，咱们家里也就你和你姊姊两个闺女，你好意思喊小。”两人出生相差不到两刻，小小的襁褓放在一块根本分不出谁是谁，她常认得一个头两个大，晕头转向。

看向女儿细白手腕上宝石串起的链子，一个粉黄，一个粉紫，那是两娃儿小时候为了分辨她们，侯爷特地让人打的，随着两姊妹年纪渐长，金丝链子增长了，宝石也多了数颗，戴在白皙嫩亮的腕间更显光华润泽。

“我脸皮厚嘛！不像姊姊傻里傻气的，人家走了三步她还慢吞吞的走一步，让人看得着急。”有个脑子不灵光的姊姊，带出去都丢脸，好在她们各走各的路，交友圈不在同一个。

“啐！怎么能说自己姊姊傻，她是老实，不像你古灵精怪的，不知上哪学来的油滑，让我时时担心不知你什么时候会闯出祸事。”她太蹦跶了，老是不肯安分地学些姑娘家该做的女红、刺绣，一天到晚只想往外跑。

赵若瑜朝姊姊一吐舌头，表示姊姊真的很傻，但她度量大，会包容姊姊。“娘，我跟姊姊都不小了，可以管事了，你给我们几间铺子让我们学做生意，我们自个儿攒嫁妆。”
content_en:
Zhao Ruoyu associates with all the rich and powerful families. Unless they grow up to be dandy, these little boys will not be too bad when they grow up. She has already cast a net in key areas, hoping to select available people for her use.

Her current goal is to start with children from aristocratic families. If there is a better candidate, she will choose a different branch. The friendship she has gotten along with since childhood is far greater than the words of a matchmaker when she grows up.

Chapter 1 Two time-traveling women (2)

"Miss, walk slowly and be careful of the stairs." When he saw the young lady jumping down from the stairs, he turned around and made a playful face. Wen Xiang's heart tightened and she was funny and nervous. She was worried that the young lady would accidentally sprain her foot, and she and Nephrite would suffer a lot.

"Wen Xiang, Nephrite, follow closely. If you lose me, I won't wait for you." Zhao Ruojin was also very naughty in private when no one saw her.

"Miss..." The two of them were dumbfounded as they followed the master who was not walking in a straight line. The little man was walking diagonally east and west, causing them to also take detours.

There is a large lake in the Xingwu Marquis Mansion that never freezes all year round, lying between the east and west courtyards. Zhao Ruojin, who likes lakes, chose a courtyard near the lake. She had people plant green willows and peach trees on the lakeside in the east courtyard. Whenever spring comes, the peaches and willows are so beautiful.

This is the season when peach blossoms are in full bloom. Nearly a hundred peach trees are in full bloom overnight, and green willows are weeping branches. On the lake, the peach red is green, and the emerald green is a little bright green. When the wind blows, the beautiful scenery of red and green ripples on the lake.

Wow!So beautiful.The stupid Zhao Ruojin stopped again and refused to move for a long time. She felt that she was so happy. She could be reborn in the noble mansion and she was still the favored daughter. God loved her so much. She must pray to Buddha diligently to let such good days continue.

"Alas! Miss is stupid again." Nephrite smiled bitterly.

"Stop talking nonsense, the young lady is just a little stupid..." Wen Xiang also looked helpless and weakly defended his young lady.

Everyone thought that Zhao Ruojin was stupid, and this played into her heart. Although it was an unintentional move, the effect was very satisfactory to her - as the saying goes, she would never be the stupid bird that was shot down. What does it matter if she is a little stupid? Only stupid people do less things.

And the showy Hideki is working hard to express herself. She is not satisfied with her talent and fame. She wants to go to a higher level and let everyone focus on her. A story can only have one protagonist, and that is her.

"Sister, why are you coming so slowly? Your legs are not shorter than mine. How could you still fall into the lake while walking?" Seeing Zhao Ruojin's shiny black hair with dry ends, Zhao Ruoyu was extremely jealous and couldn't help but mock her.

Although the two sisters are twins with similar appearance, it does not mean that their relationship is necessarily better than that of other sisters. Just like Yuliang's complex, there is me and no other. They usually live in a lukewarm manner, and there is no trace of the warmth of biological sisters.

Usually the twins sleep in the same room, but it is not known whether the two are naturally at odds with each other, or whether they are time-travelers who value privacy. They have been living in separate rooms since they were less than three years old. Each has its own courtyard and servants to serve, and they live far apart from each other.

Zhao Ruojin guessed that Zhao Ruoyu fell into the water and died, so she was very afraid of water. She refused to move to a yard near the water, and would rather take a long way around than pass by the lake. The sisters' yards happened to be at opposite ends of the east yard.

However, this also has its advantages. The distance to the parents' main house is the same, so no one is closer than the other. However, the two young masters of the Hou Mansion live relatively close to Zhao Ruojin. The two brothers pay special attention to their silly sister, thinking that she is stupid and needs more care. On the contrary, Zhao Ruoyu is much more weird and can live a good life without having to keep an eye on her.

It's a very strange phenomenon. It's obvious that the twin sister is smart and lovable, and no one wants to be like her, but everyone cherishes the sister even more. They think that being with her is very relaxing, and there is a sense of relief that they want to leave everything behind. Even if she doesn't say a word, the irritability will slowly settle down.

"I'm looking at the fish." The fish are so beautiful swimming around.

"Looking at the fish?" It's so hateful to have a stupid sister. Why is it that I am not the legitimate eldest daughter and unique, but a fool comes out to compete with her for the glory of my eldest sister?

"Mom, the fish in the lake are fat and big. Can we catch a few to make fish soup, fry fish fillets, and make vinegar or something to try? Sister Le wants to eat it." She really wanted to take a fishing rod and sit leisurely under the peach tree and wait for the silly fish to take the bait.

Zhao Ruojin was thinking about the dish of steamed fish head, using tofu to make a milky white soup, then boiling a large pot of water to boil the fish, sprinkling dazzling red chilies on the fish, making the whole pot of red spicy soup, and finally topped with the sweet and sour fish maw, which was soft and tender and melted in your mouth.

She has the recipes of eight famous dishes in her mind, but she can't come up with any of them. She doesn't want Zhao Ruoyu to find out that she is also a "fellow traveler", so she will not follow the trend of whatever this talented sister does, but instead hides herself deeper.

Zhao Ruoyu acted too arrogantly. She wanted to show everything she knew in front of the world before she was even ten years old to show that she was really talented. However, she never thought about what abilities she would be able to demonstrate in ten years. By then, Jiang Langcai would end up being ridiculed.

Upon hearing that the eldest daughter only wanted to eat, Mrs. Xu, who was stunned for a moment, covered her lips and chuckled, "Sister Le, do you want to eat fish?"

"I think about it, I really want to!" Zhao Ruojin nodded her head in a cute and cute manner. When she said "eat", her eyes lit up like the reflection of the lake water, which was particularly radiant.

"Okay, I'll have some fish brought up later, and I'll let you drink fish soup in the evening." It's a blessing for my daughter to want to eat, so what's the harm in satisfying her?Her stupidity is endearing.

"Well, mother is so kind. A child who is loved by a mother is like a treasure." She chuckled, neither acting coquettish nor getting close, her bright eyes as clear as a lake.

"Silly girl..." How can a mother not love her child? This is a piece of flesh that has fallen off her body.

"Mom, don't love me anymore. I am the little daughter you love most." Zhao Ruoyu, who was always competing for favor, suddenly got into her mother's arms. Taking advantage of her small age and being favored, she rubbed her mother's chest again and again, acting like she was domineering and this place belongs to me.

"It hurts. It hurts. You are all my daughters. There is no reason why it shouldn't hurt." Mrs. Xu held her youngest daughter in one hand and held her eldest daughter's soft little hand with the other, smiling with satisfaction.

Having children is enough for everything. She has children and a daughter. If she is not satisfied anymore, she will be struck by lightning. She is very satisfied with her current life.

"Mom loves me more, I'm the youngest." Zhao Ruoyu doesn't have a bad heart, but she likes to be first. She puts her first in everything. Only when she doesn't want others can she take over.

Xu smiled and tapped her nose, "I thought the real brother was the youngest."

Zhao Yongzhen was four years old and the youngest child in the Xingwu Hou Mansion.

"It's different. He is the youngest in our family, and I am the youngest among the sisters." She still has some affection for her younger brother.

"Haha, you and your sister are the only two girls in our family. You have the nerve to call me little." The two were born less than two minutes apart. The little swaddling clothes were put together and it was impossible to tell who was who. She often recognized one head and two big ones, which made her dizzy.

She looked at the chain with precious stones on her daughter's thin white wrist. One was pink and yellow, and the other was pink and purple. In order to distinguish the two children when they were young, the Marquis had specially made them. As the two sisters grew older, the gold chain grew and there were a few more gems. It looked even more lustrous and lustrous when worn on the fair and tender wrists.

"I'm so thick-skinned! Unlike my elder sister who is so silly and stupid, she takes one step slowly after three steps, which makes people look worried." There is a sister who is not smart and it would be embarrassing to take her out. Fortunately, they go their own ways and don't have the same circle of friends.

"Hey! How can you say that your sister is stupid? She is honest, unlike you who are quirky and slick. I don't know where you learned your slickness. It makes me always worried that you will get into trouble." She is too jumpy, always unwilling to learn some sequins and embroidery that girls should do, and just wants to run out all day long.

Zhao Ruoyu stuck out her tongue at her sister, saying that her sister was really stupid, but she was tolerant and would tolerate her sister."Mom, my sister and I are old enough to take care of things. You can give us a few shops so we can learn how to do business, and we can save our own dowries."
